title: Home Part 1: Home and Its Surroundings
summary: Get to know the home and its surroundings: the parts of a house, the rooms, the yard, clean water, and how to keep them clean.

pages.title: My Home
pages.text: A home is where we live with our family. At home we sleep, eat, study, and play. A clean home makes us comfortable and healthy.
pages.fact: A home protects us from heat, rain, and wind. Every home has a different shape, but all are places to shelter.
pages.reflection: Alhamdulillah, Allah gives us a home as a safe and comfortable place.

pages.title: Parts of a House
pages.text: A house has several parts. The roof protects us from rain and heat. The door is the way in and out. The windows let in light and air. The walls divide the rooms inside.
pages.fact: Windows that are often opened keep the air inside the house fresh and healthy.
pages.reflection: Subhanallah, every part of a house is made to keep us comfortable.

pages.title: The Living Room
pages.text: In the living room we receive guests. There is a table, chairs, and a flower vase. We sit politely and greet guests kindly. A tidy room makes guests feel at home.
pages.fact: Respecting guests is a good habit. The Prophet taught us to honour guests.
pages.reflection: Alhamdulillah, the living room is a place to gather and welcome guests.

pages.title: Eating Together as a Family
pages.text: At home we eat together with our family. Before eating we wash our hands and say a prayer. After eating, we help clear the table.
pages.fact: Eating together as a family brings us closer. Saying a prayer before eating is a good habit.
pages.reflection: Alhamdulillah, eating together with family is a blessing to be thankful for.

pages.title: The Yard
pages.text: In the yard we plant trees and flowers. A fence keeps the house safe. A green yard makes the house cool and beautiful.
pages.fact: Plants in the yard help soak up rainwater so it does not puddle.
pages.reflection: Subhanallah, a green yard makes the home cooler and more beautiful.

pages.title: The Well and Clean Water
pages.text: Many homes have a well as a source of water. Clean water is used for drinking, cooking, bathing, and washing. We must save water and not pollute it.
pages.fact: Clean water is an important need. Covering the well and not throwing rubbish into it keeps the water clean.
pages.reflection: Alhamdulillah, clean water is a blessing we must protect and be thankful for.

pages.title: The Neighbourhood
pages.text: Outside the home there is the neighbourhood: neighbours, roads, and other houses. We live side by side with our neighbours. Greeting and helping one another makes the neighbourhood pleasant.
pages.fact: Respecting neighbours is a good teaching. A peaceful neighbourhood makes life calm.
pages.reflection: Alhamdulillah, Allah created us to live together and help one another.

pages.title: Keeping Home and Surroundings Clean
pages.text: A clean home and neighbourhood keep us healthy. We sweep, put rubbish in the bin, and do not scribble on the walls. Keeping clean is a shared responsibility.
pages.fact: Piled-up rubbish can become a home for disease and smells. Putting rubbish in the bin prevents illness.
pages.reflection: Alhamdulillah, keeping the home clean is a way to be thankful and stay healthy.
